PluginData.Tooltip: Unload docks for mining ships, name-tag cargo sorting ([Ore], [Parts P1] ...) and storage tidying.
PluginData.Description:
Automatic cargo handling for Space Engineers 2.
Unload docks: name a connector [Unload] and docked ships drop their ore (or [Unload All] for everything). Sorting: name containers [Ore], [Ice], [Parts], [Ammo], [Tools], [Consumables], [Cells], [Misc], [Player], with priority like [Ore P1]. Single items: [Si], [Iron Ore], [Rifle]. LCD screens: [Cargo], [Cargo Ore], [Cargo Alerts] - fill bars, item lists, last delivery. Tidy: the same item is packed into as few containers as possible.
Items only move through conveyors. Turrets, reactors, production inputs and unknown blocks are never touched. Single player and self-hosted worlds. Don't combine with other sorting plugins.
Bugs and ideas: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Cargo-Manager/issues
